Native sampled shape-watershed stages

cpp/shape_watershed.hpp adapts the EDM-specific processing in ImageJ 1.54p
MaximumFinder, by Michael Schmid and Wayne Rasband. GUI, ImageJ processor,
ROI, display/counting and non-EDM paths are excluded. Native ownership,
cancellation, memory and traversal admission are implemented for qupathxx.
The distance map uses qupathxx's exact squared-Euclidean transform rather
than ImageJ's approximate 8SSEDT implementation.

ImageJ describes itself as public-domain software:
https://imagej.net/ij/docs/intro.html

Versioned algorithm source:
https://github.com/imagej/ImageJ/blob/v1.54p/ij/plugin/filter/MaximumFinder.java
https://github.com/imagej/ImageJ/blob/v1.54p/ij/plugin/filter/EDM.java

This attribution does not select a license for the qupathxx project.
